name: system-design
description: Guides principal-level system design, capacity planning, architecture trade-offs, and produces a validated SYSTEM-DESIGN.md.

interface.shortDescription: Design, critique, and document scalable software architectures
interface.longDescription: Run a staged architecture engagement: clarify functional and non-functional requirements, estimate capacity, draw the high-level design, choose data stores, expose trade-offs and failure modes, and cover security, observability, and resilience. Produces a traceable SYSTEM-DESIGN.md with ADRs, risks, SLOs, and a validation gate.
defaultPrompt: Design this system with me and produce SYSTEM-DESIGN.md
Critique my architecture for scalability, trade-offs, and failure modes
